body:
Title: Black Abyss
Creator(s): MeggsAndBacon
Teams: Black, White, Brown and Grey
Album: http://imgur.com/a/qQBQJ
Download and yml: https://www.dropbox.com/sh/00xuvwbwmif9xuz/AADvziWSmozGjrPFhUeCHVyUa?dl=0

(please note that this is my second time attempting a yml so sorry if its messed up).

I wanted to create some sort of "arena" walls map in order to draw players towards the middle for better and more interesting gameplay. If there are any issues with it please let me know.
